newsitem.title: UK: Dixons says current sales up 11 percent.
newsitem.headline: Dixons says current sales up 11 percent.

text.p: Electricals retailer Dixons Group Plc said like for like sales were up 11 percent in the first 18 weeks of its current financial year and gross margins remained firm.
Chairman Sir Stanley Kalms gave the trading update at the company's annual meeting.
"Sales growth over the summer has been highly satisfactory, particularly in view of last year's strong performance during July and August," he said.
The group's total retail sales in the 18 weeks were 28 percent ahead of the same period a year ago, Kalms said.
He also announced Dixons was planning to open its first store in the Irish Republic.
